questions.description: 用 while 实现十进制转任意进制。
questions.code_template:
def to_base(n, base):
    digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
    result = ""
    while n > 0:
        result = digits[n % base] + result
        n //= base
    return result
print(___, to_base(100, 2))
questions.solution:
def to_base(n, base):
    digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
    result = ""
    while n > 0:
        result = digits[n % base] + result
        n //= base
    return result
print(to_base(255, 16), to_base(100, 2))

questions.description: 用 while 实现大数乘法（字符串）。
questions.code_template:
def str_multiply(s, n):
    result = ""
    carry = 0
    i = len(s) - 1
    while i >= 0:
        prod = int(s[i]) * n + carry
        result = str(prod % 10) + result
        carry = prod // 10
        i -= 1
    if carry:
        result = str(carry) + result
    return result
print(___)
questions.solution:
def str_multiply(s, n):
    result = ""
    carry = 0
    i = len(s) - 1
    while i >= 0:
        prod = int(s[i]) * n + carry
        result = str(prod % 10) + result
        carry = prod // 10
        i -= 1
    if carry:
        result = str(carry) + result
    return result
print(str_multiply("123", 3))

        y = int(b[j]) if j >= 0 else 0
